```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(GENESPACE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biostrings)
library(data.table)
library(gt)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
read.tb <- function(path, method) {
  files <- list.files(path, full.names = TRUE, pattern = 'quality.csv', recursive = TRUE)
  tb <- map_dfr(files, function(x) {data.frame(fread(x))})
  return(tb)
}
```

After synteny with P.effusa, we have new assembly files where some of the contigs are glued. Let's check their qualities.

```{r echo=FALSE}
read.tb('~/project_data/downy/Scaffold/', 'final assembly') |> 
  cbind(sample = c('p_effusa', 'Quessda_MSU1','Quessda_Phumuli','Quessda_SC1982'))|>
  relocate(sample) |> 
  gt() |> fmt_number()
```

# Read Length

```{r echo=FALSE}
read.length <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/Scaffold/', pattern = '.fasta.gz', full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) |> 
  map_dfr(function(file) {
    seq <- readDNAStringSet(file)
    data.frame(sample = str_remove(basename(file), '.fasta.gz'),
               contig = names(seq),
               length = width(seq))
    }) |> group_by(sample) |> 
  arrange(desc(length)) |>
  top_n(30) |> 
  mutate(rank = 1:n()) |> 
  mutate(ragtag = if_else(str_detect(contig, '_RagTag'), 'scaffold' ,'unplaced contigs')) |> 
  ungroup()

read.length$sample <- factor(read.length$sample, levels = c("p_effusa", "Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli"))

ggplot(read.length, aes(x = factor(rank), y = length, fill = ragtag)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  facet_wrap(~sample, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 30 Longest Contigs",
    subtitle = "Ordered by length",
    x = "Rank",
    y = "Length (bp)"
  )
```
